cipher.name: VowelConsonantShift
cipher.idea: A simple, highly readable substitution cipher designed to minimize LLM reasoning errors. It shifts vowels to the next vowel in the sequence (a->e, e->i, i->o, o->u, u->a) and consonants to the next consonant in the alphabet, preserving case. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
1. Identify if the character is a letter. If not, keep it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u), shift it to the next vowel in the circular sequence: a -> e, e -> i, i -> o, o -> u, u -> a. Maintain uppercase/lowercase (e.g., A -> E, U -> A).
3. If it is a consonant, shift it to the next consonant in the alphabetical sequence, skipping vowels: b->c, c->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l, l->m, m->n, n->p, p->q, q->r, r->s, s->t, t->v, v->w, w->x, x->y, y->z, z->b. Maintain uppercase/lowercase (e.g., B -> C, Z -> B).
cipher.decrypt_rules:
1. Identify if the character is a letter. If not, keep it unchanged.
2. If it is a vowel, shift it to the previous vowel in the circular sequence: e -> a, i -> e, o -> i, u -> o, a -> u. Maintain uppercase/lowercase.
3. If it is a consonant, shift it to the previous consonant in the alphabetical sequence, skipping vowels: c->b, d->c, f->d, g->f, h->g, j->h, k->j, l->k, m->l, n->m, p->n, q->p, r->q, s->r, t->s, v->t, w->v, x->w, y->x, z->y, b->z. Maintain uppercase/lowercase.
